company.name: Mariana Minerals
company.shortDescription: Mariana Minerals develops mineral projects using technology to supply critical minerals for energy, AI, and defense applications.
company.description: Mariana Minerals is a vertically integrated minerals company that develops and operates mineral projects focused on supplying critical minerals. The company combines mining operations with software and technology systems to improve mineral exploration, project development, processing, and operational efficiency. Its activities include the development of lithium, copper, nickel, and other mineral resources used in energy, AI, and defense-related applications.
